concept.name: Observability-Driven Testing
concept.tagline: Observability-Driven Testing: practical patterns, trade-offs, and failure modes for production engineering teams.

spark.summary: Observability-Driven Testing is a foundational topic in Software Quality & Testing. Engineers use it to make predictable trade-offs under load, failure, and evolving requirements.
spark.keyTakeaway: Adopt Observability-Driven Testing when its operational assumptions match your scale, consistency needs, and team skills.

concept.whyItMatters: Observability-Driven Testing influences reliability, cost, and delivery speed. Misapplying it creates outages, data bugs, or unmaintainable systems.

deepDive.markdownContent:
## Observability-Driven Testing

This deep dive walks through when to apply **Observability-Driven Testing**, how it interacts with adjacent patterns, and which signals prove it is working in production.

### Operating checklist

- Define success metrics and failure budgets.
- Validate behavior under partial outages.
- Keep runbooks and diagrams current for on-call engineers.

caseStudy.problem: Repeated incidents traced to gaps in Observability-Driven Testing practices
caseStudy.solution: Standardized Observability-Driven Testing with explicit invariants, dashboards, and game-day exercises
caseStudy.impact: Lower MTTR and fewer customer-impacting regressions
